correctness.rationale: The active affine equilibrium gives p,q and the stated open feasibility interval. After shifting to this equilibrium and rescaling the second neuron's deviations by 1/σ, the symmetric and antisymmetric modes decouple. The symmetric 2×2 block has negative trace and positive determinant; the antisymmetric block has trace zero and determinant ω²>0. A nonzero stable component cannot return after a positive period, and this argument applies even when a nonnegative periodic orbit touches the thresholds, where the affine and rectified vector fields agree. On the center plane u=v+τ_y v̇, with v harmonic of amplitude ρ, so max |u|=Kρ. Both firing inequalities hold iff Kρ<=min(p,q/σ), which excludes nonconstant orbits at either endpoint or outside the interval. The projected map from harmonic coordinates has constant Jacobian ωτ_y, and the two orthogonal embedding columns give intrinsic area multiplier 1+σ². The two positive affine bounds increase and decrease respectively, crossing only at r=σ, so radius and area have a unique maximum there; both threshold contacts occur at opposite phases. The exact primitive period follows from any nonzero harmonic component. Independent rational block/threshold checks at (τ_x,τ_y,b,σ,s_1)=(2,3,2,3/2,7/5) give R²=3/400,3/100,3/400 for r=7/6,3/2,21/10 and the predicted graze multiplicities (python /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 1). Those checks supplement the argument; the frozen SymPy script was inspected but not executed.

value.rationale: The active excursion envelope is a natural quantity for models of firing-threshold contact. However the same envelope, period and contact multiplicity are already supplied by the exact indexed center family. The remaining area and optimum simply measure that known ellipsoid by a fixed Jacobian and maximize the square of its known piecewise-affine cutoff. They do not supply an independently unknown invariant or a substantive residual boundary classification under the scientific value criterion. No repair is proposed; a different switching or optimization problem would require a new result, not an edit to this one.
